title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: [Sony TC-110 with built-in mic > reel > cassette > CD] + [AKG190E > Uher 400L > Technics 1506 playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > CD] > Samsung SW-232B > EAC v0.9b4 > CD Wave > shntool > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Legendary performance shines through a very muddy audience recording – Dark Star and the Sugar Magnolia/Love‑Light stretch are the highlights.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its epic Dark Star (ranked among the top ten) and the sweet run from Sugar Magnolia into Love Light, but the two AUD tapes (Weinberg and Toner) are so muffled that the music is often indistinguishable. A matrix of the second half of the second set offers a clearer glimpse, yet listeners with “delicate doily ears” will find the bass overwhelming.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers agree the musical performance is strong (especially Dark Star and Sugar Magnolia/Love‑Light) but condemn the audience recordings as poor, resulting in a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Both AUD tapes are described as muffled, muddy and bass‑heavy; occasional SBD (soundboard) portion helps but the bulk of the recording is low fidelity. A matrix version of part of the second set provides better clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is the focal point – the Dark Star and the latter half of the set are highlighted, while the early part suffers from recording issues that mask the performance.
